extracted.name: Chocolate Cupcakes
extracted.description: When we think of Cupcakes we usually think of the shape circle but why not make a cupcake with a different shape? Today I am making cupcakes arrow-shaped. Try this recipe to make nice and moist chocolate cupcakes.
instruction_lines: Add the first 6 ingredients in a bowl and mix well. Now add rest of the ingredients and mix well.
Bake in a preheated oven for 18 to 20 minutes at 180°C.
